title: Automation Success Rate by Routine
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST - forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event event_type=automation_completed
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(result="success")) as success by automation
| eval success_pct=round(100*success/runs,1)
| where runs>=5 AND success_pct<95
| sort success_pct
description: Computes a per-automation success rate so you can stop treating every failed routine as an isolated annoyance.
value: A home feels reliable when its routines are boringly consistent; success-rate math shows which automation is the real repeat offender.
implementation: Forward completion and result fields for each automation; review daily and repair routines that keep landing below target.
visualization: Table of automations by run count and success percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks which home routines keep failing often enough that they are not reliable anymore.
